thread:
maya: FYI seeing intermittent 401s on streaming completions for customers using a corporate HTTP proxy + PRIVATE_ENDPOINT. Seems to spike on reconnect after a transient network glitch. :thinking:

samir: Can you drop a minimal repro (env + SDK config + a tiny log snippet)?

maya: repro below. .env:
```
REDWOOD_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT=https://private.redwood.example
HTTP_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:8080
REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted
```
node snippet:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseUrl: process.env.REDWOOD_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT });
await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-beta', messages: [...] });
```
log: stream opens fine, then after a reconnect sequence the next chunk fails with 401 from upstream.

oliver: My guess: the proxy is stripping Authorization on the reconnect flow (CONNECT/upgrade semantics) or there's a redirect to a host that doesn't accept the short-lived token. Some proxies drop/fail to forward headers during reconnects.

jen: Can the SDK inspect headers on the reconnect handshake? If Authorization isn't present we know it's a proxy issue vs token expiry. Also check whether token refresh is invoked before we re-open the socket.

maya: corp-proxy team says they normally forward headers for CONNECT but will drop them if an intermediate 302 occurs. I couldn't get a header dump from staging yet.

paul: Short-term mitigation we can add in the SDK: explicitly reattach Authorization from the token provider when performing a reconnect, instead of relying on OS/socket state. Add an option like `preserveAuthOnReconnect` (opt-in) so customers behind quirky proxies can enable it.

samir: Implementation details I propose:
- On reconnect path, call tokenProvider.getToken() and set Authorization header on the new handshake request.
- For streaming, ensure the token is fetched and added before sending any bytes so upstream sees it on the resumed connection.
- Emit a telemetry flag when this code path is exercised.

maya: We should also validate baseUrl resolution on reconnect: env var -> client config -> per-call override. If reconnect recomputes baseUrl differently we might hit the wrong host and get 401.

oliver: Agreed. Add a shared resolveBaseUrl(reqOptions) that both initial connect and reconnect call.

paul: Small UX nit: name the flag `preserveAuthOnReconnect` (camelCase) and default it to false. Document it in the SDK config section.

samir: I'll open a PR with tests. Plan:
1) add flag (default false) and hook tokenProvider on reconnect
2) unit test for reconnect header reattach logic
3) integration test with a tiny proxy that strips Authorization on first connect
4) add docs & telemetry

maya: Test idea: run a small proxy in CI that strips Authorization for the initial handshake then allows traffic once the header is present. Assert stream resumes after we fetch+attach token.

jen: Can reviewers please look? @samir (owner), @oliver (network), @maya (integration). We'd like a quick review in ~24h to make the 1.4.2 patch.

dev-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3251 — samir: preserve-auth-reconnect

paul: Quick review: design LGTM. One tiny change request: factor out baseUrl resolution helper into utils so both paths share it.

samir: Will do. Updating PR with tests; switching flag name to `preserveAuthOnReconnect`.

maya: I'll validate in staging behind corp-proxy after merge and report back.

oliver: :thumbsup: after deploy keep an eye on reconnect telemetry and 401s.

jen: Adding this to patch release checklist and a short incident note so support has context.

maya: Resolving for now, will follow up with staging results. :eyes:
